pinterest.title: Santorini Wedding Season: Weather by Month from Official Station Data
pinterest.description: Santorini has no official weather station of its own, so our guide uses Naxos, the nearest one. There, June to August are the driest months, May and September run cooler than July and August, and October brings 38.6 mm of rain over 5.5 days. The prevailing wind blows from the north in every month. Plan the ceremony time around summer heat and the wind, and keep a covered fallback in place.

pinterest.title: Santorini Wedding Venues: Caldera Terraces, Wineries, Hotels and Villas
pinterest.description: Settle the kind of place before the name. Caldera terraces at Grace Hotel in Imerovigli and Canaves Oia, winery terraces at Santo Wines in Pyrgos and Venetsanos Winery, hotel spaces across Katikies in Oia, Imerovigli and Fira, and private villas each differ in capacity, wind and where guests sleep. Our step by step guide sets out what to ask each one before you sign.

pinterest.title: Planning a Santorini Wedding: Sizing Your Guest List Against Capacity
pinterest.description: On the caldera, space is scarce. The caldera-edge spaces in Oia and Imerovigli seat between 15 and 60, so check your guest list against the seated number, not the standing one. Above 60 seated, look at a standing reception, splitting events across spaces, or a larger terrace such as the Upper Terrace at Venetsanos Winery, which seats about 100. Our guide includes a capacity table for six venues.

slides: Santorini is the choice, or very nearly. What you need now is the order in which to decide things.
Season: at Naxos, the nearest official station, June to August are the driest months. May and September run cooler than July and August, and October is wetter.
Mind the wind as much as the heat. The prevailing wind blows from the north in every month, so ask each venue which covered space is held for you.
Choose the setting before the name: a caldera terrace, a winery, a hotel with several spaces or a private villa.
Count seats, not standing room. The caldera-edge spaces in Oia and Imerovigli seat between 15 and 60.
Plan the weekend: welcome drinks at sunset, a winery afternoon, a calm morning of, and a long recovery lunch by the sea.
Get the house rules in writing before you sign: music times, exclusive use, ceremony times and the weather plan.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Planning a Santorini wedding?

Santorini sits at the southernmost point of the Cyclades, with villages spread along the rim of the caldera and beaches of black, red and white sand. That is why a Santorini wedding can mean a cliff-edge terrace in Oia one evening and a winery in Pyrgos the next.

Our new step by step guide takes the decisions in order, so each one narrows the next. It sets out weather by month from Naxos, the nearest official station, and how to plan the ceremony time around summer heat and the north wind.

It compares the settings: caldera terraces at Grace Hotel and Canaves Oia, Mystique in Oia, winery terraces at Santo Wines and Venetsanos Winery, and the Katikies hotels across Oia, Imerovigli and Fira. A capacity table helps you size your guest list, because on the caldera, space is scarce.

It closes with the house rules to settle in writing, ideas for the whole weekend and a booking checklist.

Planning your own Santorini wedding? Send us a message with your month, guest count and the venues you are weighing up. Your Wedded Advisor is a single point of contact, start to finish. Full guide at the link in our bio.
